notes: The great Moorings chain and its anchor plates are architecture (Anchorkin kit), not nature, and are not in this kit. Teal glow (glowweed, crystal veins, mere water) is emissive and reserved for points of interest; everything else stays dark and muted.

pieces.name: Salt-twisted tree, broad
pieces.notes: Thick gnarled dark-brown trunk bent hard to one side by the wind, buttress roots splayed over dark stone; one wide flat-topped crown of clumped dull olive-green foliage masses.

pieces.name: Salt-twisted tree, tall S-bend
pieces.notes: Twisting S-curved trunk, a high main crown and a lower side branch with its own small crown pad; dull olive-green clumps, dark bark with grey salt streaks.

pieces.name: Salt-twisted tree, low
pieces.notes: Low, almost creeping tree: trunk sprawls sideways along the ground, then rises into a single wide shallow crown. Same bark and foliage as a and b.

pieces.name: Dead snag, tall
pieces.notes: Bleached silver-grey dead trunk leaning away from the storm, split base, bare forked branches reaching up and sideways; deep cracks and stripped grain, a little moss at the foot.

pieces.name: Dead snag, broken
pieces.notes: Shorter snapped-off bleached trunk leaning hard, jagged top, two or three short dead branches.

pieces.name: Reed bed
pieces.notes: Dense clump of tall straight reeds in olive and straw green with tawny-gold seed heads, a dark stone at the base. Alpha-card blades in a few crossed clusters.

pieces.name: Glowweed
pieces.notes: Low dark-green leafy clump with a fan of slender stalks ending in bulb-tipped fronds that glow soft teal (emissive). Grows among dark pebbles at water edges.

pieces.name: Drift timber pile
pieces.notes: Pile of crossed grey weathered logs and sticks, silver driftwood grain, a strand of olive weed draped over one end. Deadfall rather than understory; placed by hand on shores and in chain pools.

pieces.name: Shells and crab shells
pieces.notes: Scatter of cream and pale-pink spiral and scallop shells, plus an empty rust-orange shellback crab carapace and loose claws. Shore and sand scatter.

pieces.name: Salt grass tuft, tall
pieces.notes: Sparse tough tuft of thin olive-yellow blades, splayed. Alpha cards.

pieces.name: Salt grass tuft, short
pieces.notes: Small low tuft of the same salt grass, for thinning out the tall tufts.

pieces.name: Wet moss patch
pieces.notes: Flat cushion of damp olive moss with small fleshy succulent-like leaf rosettes at the edge; slight wet sheen.

pieces.name: Basalt boulder, veined
pieces.notes: Rounded dark grey basalt boulder, moss on the crown, thin glowing teal crystal veins across one face.

pieces.name: Low column slab
pieces.notes: Low broken run of hexagonal basalt column tops, flat stepped faces, moss in the joints.

pieces.name: Column outcrop
pieces.notes: Cluster of upright hexagonal basalt columns of stepped heights, flat tops capped with moss.

pieces.name: Leaning boulder
pieces.notes: Angular dark slate boulder tilted to one side, layered faces, a few faint teal flecks, moss on the upper edge.

pieces.name: Slanted slate spire
pieces.notes: Tall sheared slab of dark layered slate rising at a slant, sharp top edge, several glowing teal crystal veins running up the face, moss in the ledges.

pieces.name: Mere edge
pieces.notes: Curved section of a round mere rim: dark stacked basalt blocks stepping down into still teal-glowing water (emissive water surface with faint swirl, lily pads), reeds and salt grass on the bank. Rim pieces chain into a full circle.

pieces.name: Lip ledge with trickle
pieces.notes: Isle edge segment: slick dark basalt ledges stepping out over the edge, tufted salt grass and reeds on top, long olive moss and weed hanging over the face, a thin waterfall trickle spilling from a notch, teal vein glints.

pieces.name: Lip ledge
pieces.notes: Same edge segment without the trickle and notch, for the long runs between falls. Derived from the sheet piece.

pieces.name: Underside spire, large
pieces.notes: Inverted tapering spike of dark basalt, near-vertical column facets, streaked darker by spray, olive weed strands hanging from the top rim, teal vein flecks and water drips at the point.

pieces.name: Underside spire, small
pieces.notes: Shorter, stubbier taper of the same rock for narrow edges and small isles. Derived from the sheet piece.
